sequence.label: Initial outreach
sequence.goal: Warm, catchy milestone hook + tailored operational insight & high-open-rate subject line
sequence.subj: Solving post-acquisition stack & data silos at Stripe — how GODYS unifies primary offering in weeks
sequence.body:
Hi David,

Hope you’re having a great week! Huge congratulations on Stripe’s move to acquire OpenRouter—and seeing the move to bring OpenRouter into the fold makes it clear how fast things are moving at Stripe right now.

When fintech and payments CTOs bring a newly acquired AI or platform capability into the fold, the hidden bottleneck is rarely the vision—it's unifying model routing, real-time telemetry, and enterprise governance across both stacks without slowing down product shipping.

At GODYS, we help fintech and payments engineering teams stand up unified primary offering architectures and automated data pipelines in weeks rather than quarters.

Would you be open to a quick look at the 2-page architecture playbook we used for a similar fintech and payments scale-up, or a brief 10-minute chat next week? Either way, wishing you and the Stripe team continued momentum!

Warm regards,
GODFRAY
GODYS

sequence.label: LinkedIn connect
sequence.goal: Polite, warm connection note referencing their news + friendly practitioner question
sequence.subj: Eliminating post-merger integration friction at Stripe with GODYS
sequence.body:
Hi David, hope your week is going great! Sent a quick note by email earlier regarding bringing OpenRouter into the Stripe fold.

Curious: as you integrate these capabilities into Stripe’s core stack, how is your team keeping cross-platform data and governance plumbing from slowing down Q4 delivery?

Would love to stay connected here either way!

sequence.label: Value follow-up
sequence.goal: Warm value-add follow-up connecting secondary signal to a concrete 2-page playbook
sequence.subj: How GODYS cuts post-acquisition data & workflow integration from quarters to weeks for Stripe
sequence.body:
Hi David,

Hope your week is going smoothly! Thinking about bringing OpenRouter into the Stripe fold alongside bringing OpenRouter into the Stripe fold, keeping cross-system data and workflow handoffs clean usually becomes the #1 priority for technology & strategy teams.

We recently helped a fast-moving fintech and payments team in a very similar spot deploy our primary offering to automate data reconciliation and workflow orchestration in under 45 days—freeing their core engineers to focus 100% on product velocity.

Would you be open to me sending over the 2-page teardown of how they architected it? No pressure at all—just thought it might be a useful reference for your team.

Warm regards,
GODFRAY
GODYS

sequence.label: Breakup / check-in
sequence.goal: Warm, polite, zero-pressure close-the-loop note cheering on their team
sequence.subj: De-risking Stripe's stack integration — GODYS is ready when you are, David
sequence.body:
Hi David,

I can imagine how packed your schedule is as CTO with bringing OpenRouter into the Stripe fold in full swing, so I’ll make this my last note for now.

If scaling AI & platform execution or freeing up engineering bandwidth ever becomes a priority later this year, I’d always be delighted to share what’s working for other fintech and payments teams.

Until then, wishing you and the entire Stripe team huge success with the rollout!

Warm regards,
GODFRAY
GODYS

sequence.label: Initial outreach
sequence.goal: Warm, catchy milestone hook + tailored operational insight & high-open-rate subject line
sequence.subj: Eliminating enterprise AI inference & data-pipeline bottlenecks at Cloudflare — how GODYS solves it
sequence.body:
Hi Dane,

Hope you’re having a great week! I really enjoyed reading in Cloudflare Blog about Cloudflare’s momentum with AI Platform: an inference layer designed for agents—and seeing the recent update in Cloudflare on OS Is the First AI Workspace Built Around makes it clear how fast things are moving at Cloudflare right now.

As initiatives like this scale across Cloudflare, the toughest part is rarely the core software or AI model—it's getting clean, governed data flowing across systems without pulling senior engineers off the main roadmap.

At GODYS, we help emerging tech leaders deploy our primary offering to automate those underlying pipelines and cut months of custom integration work out of the critical path.

Would you be open to a quick look at the 2-page architecture playbook we used for a similar cloud and security scale-up, or a brief 10-minute chat next week? Either way, wishing you and the Cloudflare team continued momentum!

Warm regards,
GODFRAY
GODYS

sequence.label: Value follow-up
sequence.goal: Warm value-add follow-up connecting secondary signal to a concrete 2-page playbook
sequence.subj: How GODYS cuts custom primary offering integration work by 60% for Cloudflare
sequence.body:
Hi Dane,

Hope your week is going smoothly! Thinking about your work on AI Platform: an inference layer designed for agents alongside your work on OS Is the First AI Workspace Built Around, keeping cross-system data and workflow handoffs clean usually becomes the #1 priority for technology & strategy teams.

We recently helped a fast-moving cloud and security team in a very similar spot deploy our primary offering to automate data reconciliation and workflow orchestration in under 45 days—freeing their core engineers to focus 100% on product velocity.

Would you be open to me sending over the 2-page teardown of how they architected it? No pressure at all—just thought it might be a useful reference for your team.

Warm regards,
GODFRAY
GODYS

sequence.label: Breakup / check-in
sequence.goal: Warm, polite, zero-pressure close-the-loop note cheering on their team
sequence.subj: Removing platform scaling hurdles at Cloudflare — GODYS is here when timing aligns, Dane
sequence.body:
Hi Dane,

I can imagine how packed your schedule is as SVP Emerging Tech with your work on AI Platform: an inference layer designed for agents at Cloudflare in full swing, so I’ll make this my last note for now.

If scaling AI & platform execution or freeing up engineering bandwidth ever becomes a priority later this year, I’d always be delighted to share what’s working for other cloud and security teams.

Until then, wishing you and the entire Cloudflare team huge success with the rollout!

Warm regards,
GODFRAY
GODYS

Speer: Company Profile

This profile is based on what the Speer product in your workspace actually does: the six-stage AI pipeline, prospect research, outreach angles, multi-step sequences and quality checks.

1. Company Snapshot
	
Company name	Speer
Category	B2B sales intelligence and AI outreach (SaaS plus optional managed services)
Tagline	Research smarter. Discover opportunities.
What it does	Turns any target company's website and news into an evidence-backed account brief, a map of who makes buying decisions, recommended sales angles and a ready-to-send multi-step outreach sequence
Customers	B2B sellers: SDR/BDR teams, account executives, founders doing sales themselves, agencies and revenue operations leaders
Business model	Subscription platform (per seat, with tiers by usage), plus "done-with-you" and "done-for-you" service add-ons
Core belief	Every outreach should start from a real, checkable reason to reach out
2. The Problem Speer Solves

B2B prospecting usually goes wrong in one of two ways:

Too slow. A rep spends 30–60 minutes per account reading the website, news, LinkedIn and job posts before writing one good email. That doesn't scale.
Too generic. Automation tools send thousands of mail-merge templates. Reply rates fall, sending domains get burned, and buyers learn to ignore the sender's brand.

Speer sits in between. It automates the research so you get personalised outreach at the speed of automation, and every claim in the message ties back to a real source.

3. What Speer Offers
3.1 The Speer Platform (core product)
A. Live prospect research

Enter a company name or domain and Speer researches it live:

Company summary: what they do, who they sell to, where they operate, how big they are and where they're heading.
Firmographics: industry, headquarters, employee range and domain.
Recent developments: a dated list of buying signals, each with a source.
B. Buying-signal detection

Speer sorts what it finds into signal types that suggest someone is ready to buy:

Leadership: new CTO, CIO or COO appointments, which often trigger vendor reviews.
Expansion: new plants, hubs, regions or retail rollouts.
Hiring: clusters of open roles that show where money is going (for example AI/ML engineers or data platform engineers).
Technology: legacy system migrations and modernisation plans.
M&A: acquisitions that force systems to be merged.
Capital spending: announced upgrades or investments with budget behind them.

Each signal comes with a relevance rating (High / Medium / Low), a "why it matters" explanation, the source and the date.

C. Decision-maker mapping
Identifies the buying committee, such as the economic buyer, technical evaluator and operational champion.
Gives each person's role, department, a short bio and their LinkedIn.
Lets you add your own contacts manually.
D. Outreach angles

Speer matches the target's signals to what your company sells (from your "My Company" profile) and suggests several strategic angles. Each angle includes:

A one-line pitch
The signals behind it
The offering it maps to
The best recipient roles
Why this angle fits this buyer

You can also write your own custom angle.

E. Multi-step sequence writing

Speer writes a full multi-touch outreach sequence based on the chosen angle and contact:

A timeline of steps (Day 1, Day 3, Day 7, and so on) with a subject and message for each.
Shows which evidence each sequence uses.
Fits a sender persona and defaults you set once (tone, sign-off, role).
F. Quality and grounding checks

Before anything is sent, a quality check reviews every draft:

Is each claim backed by a collected source?
Is the message relevant to this recipient?
Are the tone, length and spam-risk acceptable?

Speer flags anything it can't back up, so made-up claims never reach a buyer.

G. Workspace
Prospects directory: every researched account with status (Completed or Partial) and outreach state (Draft or Approved).
Outreach sequences and drafts: review, edit, approve and export.
My Company: your company name, category, domain, solutions description and persona. Speer uses this to personalise everything.
3.2 The Speer Intelligence Engine (how it works)

Speer runs each prospect through a six-stage AI pipeline:

Stage	What it does
1. Live Website DOM Harvester	Reads the prospect's live website for positioning, products, customers and locations
2. Google News & Press Signal Collector	Gathers recent press releases, news and announcements
3. AI Prospect & Buying Committee Synthesizer	Builds the company summary and identifies the decision-makers
4. OKF Knowledge Graph & ICM Attribution	Links every fact to its source so claims can be traced
5. Multi-Step Sequence Copywriter	Writes the angle-specific, multi-touch sequence
6. Grounding & Quality Critic Audit	Checks drafts against the evidence and blocks unsupported claims

The result is outreach where every sentence can be traced back to a source.

3.3 Speer Services (on top of the software)

Speer also offers people-led services for teams that want help, not just software:

Onboarding and ICP workshop: defines your ideal customer, offerings, proof points and persona inside Speer.
Signal playbook design: decides which trigger events matter most for your product and how to rank them.
Messaging and angle strategy: senior copywriters refine the angle library and objection handling.
Managed outbound ("Speer Pods"): a Speer strategist, analyst and copywriter run the whole motion for you, from research to booked meetings.
Deliverability and email setup: domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, inbox warm-up and sending limits.
CRM integration: syncs prospects, signals, angles and sequence status into Salesforce, HubSpot or Pipedrive.
Training and enablement: teaches your SDRs and AEs to sell from signals.
4. Who Speer Serves
Customer type	How they use Speer
SDR/BDR teams	Cut research time from about 45 minutes to a few minutes per account
Account executives	Prepare for discovery calls with a full account brief
Founders doing sales	Run high-quality outbound without hiring a team
Agencies and consultancies	Produce personalised campaigns for many clients
RevOps and sales leaders	Standardise messaging quality and track which signals lead to pipeline

Strongest industries: enterprise software and AI, manufacturing, logistics and supply chain, food and consumer goods, heavy industry, fintech and healthcare tech. These are markets with complex buying committees and high deal values, where getting the context right matters most.

5. Example Customer Journey
Set up. A workflow automation vendor fills in its My Company profile.
Research. The rep enters Acme Manufacturing. Speer finds: a new CTO (High), a new plant in Pune (High), Southeast Asia expansion (Medium) and AI hiring (High).
Map the committee. It identifies the CTO, COO and CEO, with bios.
Pick an angle. The rep chooses "Operational efficiency: AI workflow automation as plants expand to Pune" aimed at the COO.
Generate the sequence. Speer writes a multi-touch sequence and shows the evidence behind each step.
Check quality. The critic confirms every claim is sourced.
Approve and send. The rep approves, and the sequence is saved in the drafts library (or synced to the CRM).
6. Pricing Model (example)
Plan	For	Includes
Starter	Solo sellers and founders	Limited prospect research per month, angles, sequences, quality checks
Growth	Sales teams	More research volume, shared workspace, personas, CRM export
Enterprise	Large revenue orgs	Unlimited research, SSO, custom signal models, API, dedicated success manager
Managed (Speer Pods)	Done-for-you outbound	Platform plus a dedicated strategist, analyst and copywriter, with meeting targets
7. What Sets Speer Apart
Typical tools	Speer
Static, aging contact databases	Live research on every run
Templates with {FirstName} merge tags	Messages tied to the angle and the evidence
AI writers that can make things up	Grounding critic blocks unsupported claims
Data with no strategy	Signal → angle → recipient → sequence in one flow
Software only	Software plus optional expert services
8. Mission, Vision and Values
Mission: Make every B2B conversation start with relevance.
Vision: Become the intelligence layer behind every outbound motion, where no seller reaches out without a real reason.
Values:
Evidence over assumption: if it can't be sourced, it isn't said.
Signal over volume: fewer, better conversations.
Protect the brand: our customers' reputation comes first.
Privacy by design: GDPR, CCPA and CAN-SPAM aware, using only public data.
